R1_ats_close_fade_fumble_luck.snapshot: closing line (nflverse spread_line) at its actual closing juice
R1_ats_close_fade_fumble_luck.rule: bet AGAINST the team with the better walk-forward fumble-recovery luck (own-fumble recovery rate minus opponents' recovery rate vs it, shrunk, home-minus-away) when |z| >= 1.5 (2013-19 SD scale)
R1_ats_close_fade_fumble_luck.metric: ATS ROI at closing juice; one-sided t on per-bet profit
R1_ats_close_fade_fumble_luck.dev: 2012-19: 312 bets, ROI +2.8% (t 0.52); 2020-22: 141 bets, ROI +9.7% (t 1.21); pre-specified luck hypothesis; rating has ~zero persistence (pre-game vs game corr 0.02)

R2_total_close_slow_pace_under.snapshot: closing line (nflverse total_line) at its actual closing juice
R2_total_close_slow_pace_under.rule: bet UNDER when the game's combined neutral-situation seconds-per-snap rating (both offenses and the pace both defenses allow) is >= +1.0 SD (slow game)
R2_total_close_slow_pace_under.metric: O/U ROI at closing juice; one-sided t on per-bet profit

R3_spread_tue_back_early_down_epa.snapshot: Tue 14:10 UTC (<= 7 days before kickoff), best allowed-book price, one bet per game
R3_spread_tue_back_early_down_epa.rule: back the side with the better net early-down (1st/2nd down) EPA rating when |z| >= 2.0: the Tuesday line under-reacts to it (+0.37 pt/SD move to the close, t 6.3, 2020-22)
R3_spread_tue_back_early_down_epa.metric: price-based CLV vs edge_lab.closing_fair (mu_close_sharp, else all books)
